title: Fractal Altruism: EA burnout meets inner-peace politics
summary: The quotable take is Tyler Alterman’s: “Fractal altruism: scaling altruism from inner altruism (positive relations amidst your IFS parts) to your community to the wider world”—and his spicy add-on that it’s “less direct… than trad EA, but… more likely to work (…if we can find a way to not extinct humanity in the meantime).” The real prequel is Rich Decibels’ 2020 IFS riff (“peacemaking… is a fractal process”), arguing that if you’re disowning your own selfish parts, people can smell it and won’t trust your accountability crusades—so inner reconciliation becomes the template for family/group/nation-level peace (Dick Schwartz/IFS credited).
